# PROCESS — what I did this iteration (explainability)

Edit space is **system-prompt only** (prompt.md). No tools.py exists for this capability.

## KEY DISCOVERY (from per-task rollout means, seed vs cand_0001/2)
The framework `broke={}` was misleading. cand_0002 (Δ +0.027, rejected on significance) actually:
- GAINED: 160-6 0.60→1.00, 418-29 0.87→1.00, 374-9 0.00→0.33 (via data_only).
- **REGRESSED (hidden, because these were flaky not ~1.0): 52216 0.60→0.40, 53161 0.60→0.20.**
Mechanism (confirmed by reading final code): cand_0002's "write an Excel formula" lever made the agent write formulas on the cell-level lookup/aggregation tasks (52216: literals every seed trial → formulas every cand_0002 trial; 53161: the formula trials scored 0.00, literal trials 1.00). Formulas recalc all-or-nothing and dropped the partial credit literals earned. The lever helped NOTHING (32468 stayed 0.00). Net: the regression ate the gains → insignificant.

## Ranked issue list
| rank | cluster | tasks | root cause | tag | change class |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | formula-lever regression | 52216, 53161 | cand_0002 pushed Excel formulas on cell-level lookups; formulas score 0/all, literals get partial+reliable | KNOWLEDGE (mis-steer) | REMOVE formula lever; reinforce live-read→literal |
| 2 | delete whole separator block | 347-49 | agent deletes only blank rows; gold deletes blank+label+"Gross Pay"-header block. Verified reproduces v2/v3 exactly | KNOWLEDGE | narrowing rule (fires only when explicit ranges / repeated separators) |
| 3 | read whole used range | 160-6, 418-29 | agent caps reading at checked-range last row; data below must flow in | KNOWLEDGE | answer_position=output-only rule (cand_0002-proven) |
| 4 | generalize / live-read keys | 52216, 53161, 418-29 | hardcodes selector/values/sizes; wrong lookup key | KNOWLEDGE | live-read+match-all-keys rule + worked example |
| 5 | anchor tables by header; keep orientation | 53161 | reads header row as data (off-by-one); transposes answer axes | KNOWLEDGE | anchor-below-header + preserve-orientation rule |
| 6 | read formula-cell results | 374-9 (+class) | openpyxl returns formula text; totals skip them | KNOWLEDGE | data_only=True rule (cand_0002-proven, +0.33) |

## Changes made (all in prompt.md)
| cluster | edit class | what & why it generalizes | protects passing? |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | REMOVE rule | dropped cand_0002's "writing an Excel FORMULA is equally valid / more reliable" paragraph; kept seed's "prefer LITERAL values"; added "compute literals from LIVE reads, not preview numbers" | 40467 passed under seed's prefer-literals (no lever) → unchanged; formulas not forbidden so 40467's date-concat still works |
| 2 | narrowing add | delete whole separator block ONLY when instruction gives explicit ranges or repeated separators; else plain blank-row delete | 160-6 has neither → stays plain blank-delete |
| 3 | add | answer_position = output location, read/process whole used range | 47484/40467 already read dynamically |
| 4 | add + example | live-read every selector/label/size, match ALL keys; WRONG/RIGHT worked example | passing tasks already read live |
| 5 | add | locate tables by header text, read below header, don't transpose answer block | passing tasks unaffected |
| 6 | add | data_only=True to read formula-cell cached values | passing tasks have no source formulas to read |

## Verify-the-fix (per change)
- **1 (formula lever removed):** 52216 seed=literals mean 0.60; cand_0002=formulas mean 0.40. 53161 formula trials→0.00, literal trials→1.00. Removing the lever + reinforcing literals restores/raises both; blast radius: 40467 passes under identical "prefer literals" wording in seed (no lever) → no behavior change.
- **2 (block delete):** subagent verified deleting blank+"Employee Info"+"Gross Pay"-header reproduces 347-49 answer exactly for v2/v3 (v1 differs only by a float artifact). Guard predicate = "explicit ranges / repeated separators"; 160-6 instruction has neither → rule does NOT fire → 160-6 unaffected.
- **3 (whole used range):** 160-6 failing trials capped at SH!A6:L11 and lost rows 12–14; passing trials read whole sheet. 418-29 failing trial hardcoded max_row=7; variants 2/3 have 8/10 rows. Rule already produced 1.00 on both in cand_0002 (broke={}).
- **4 (live-read):** 52216 failing trials hardcoded region/values (0.33) or read wrong sheet (0.0); passing trials read A14 live + matched (region,label). General rule + example.
- **5 (anchor/orientation):** 53161 t4 read categories from header row (off-by-one), t2 transposed axes → both 0.0; passing trials anchored below header, kept orientation.
- **6 (data_only):** 374-9 went 0.00→consistent 0.33 in cand_0002 solely via data_only; keeps the one achievable variant.

## Process & features used
- Subagents: 3 parallel read-only diagnostic subagents (52216/53161; 32468; 347-49/374-9/160-6/418-29), each cross-checked against ground-truth workbooks at `/vol/home/skillberry/.cache/capevolve-ci/spreadsheetbench-data/sample_data_200/spreadsheet/<task>/` (all 3 variants).
- Read prior_iterations cand_0001 + cand_0002 diffs + JOURNAL RESULT lines + per-task rollout means (the decisive signal).

## Good things to PRESERVE
- data_only=True rule (374-9). Whole-used-range / answer_position=output-only rule (160-6, 418-29). Live-read+match-keys rule. "Prefer LITERAL values" (do NOT re-add the formula lever — it regresses cell-level lookups).

## Deliberately skipped (data defects — unfixable by prompt; do NOT chase)
- **32468**: DISCOUNT row 2508 = 6.5 in input but −7 in answer across all 3 variants; gold computed on corrupted cell. Cell-level all-or-nothing → unwinnable.
- **374-9**: identical Sheet1 input yields contradictory answers (1× in v1, 2× for rows 7–14 in v2/v3). Ceiling 1/3; already captured via data_only.
- **55457**: instruction field is empty.
